race.description: I H Capital 0 To 2 Win Trotters Hcp
race.comment: ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (6) finished fourth last time out, beaten 7 metres, in a nice return to form at this track over 2138m. Recent efforts are good enough to win a race of this calibre. LOCHINVAR SON (4) finished second last start over 2138m at this track, beaten 1.5 metres. That was an improvement on the unplaced effort at this track the run before. Won't find this any harder and he can give this a mighty shake. MY NAMES BRUCE (2) was out of the money two starts ago then things went amiss last start when he broke and finished a distant last over 2138m at this track. Won't find this any harder and he can bounce back. BLACK VIPER (7) comes here following a fourth behind Fredidrivsamercury at Group Two level five days ago over 2138m at this track. Looms as a serious challenger.
